descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-11 Course Timeline · S05 Server clock table: which day a visit's line is filed under (device clock −3 d / +1 d, and a finish across midnight)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U9 'Today' on the timeline comes from the server clock, not the device's; a device with a wrong date, no clock set or a different time zone shows the same state as any other device. (UAT 3.8; TFA-92589 AC 7)
  • U1 One entry per completed visit, correctly dated, in chronological order, never duplicated. (UAT TC-11; TFA-92589 AC 3)

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given Browser clock skewed against the server (page.clock) or a time zone whose midnight falls during the finish; ledgers seeded per cell; model calls mocked

When Per cell: {Hospital, Nursing Home} × {Pre-Round Save; Pre-Round Save then Generate; direct Generate} × device clock −3 d (and +1 d where sign-in works); plus a Hospital finish whose refresh returns after local midnight

Then Every visit has exactly one stored line, filed under the server's today, and no line under the device's day

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright assertions on the stored ledger: one line for the visit, under the server's today, none under the device's day. Only the NH direct-Generate −3 d cell has a test on main; a Pass on S05 covers that cell only, and every other cell reports Blocked (not built) until its test exists. A +1 d cell that cannot sign in is a Fail against 3.8, cross-checked by S08. …

Where it ran: local lane A (existing Playwright tests); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S05 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-11.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane A.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: CODEREVIEW · Code review — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: matrix (lane A).

UAT item: TC-11 Course Timeline · Section: A2 · Pre-Round · Scenario: TC-11/S05

Server clock table: which day a visit's line is filed under (device clock −3 d / +1 d, and a finish across midnight)

Tickets: TFA-92589 Course Timeline (ready for qa)

Re-verdict after the QA review of TFA-92589 (2026-10-14; not yet checked by Quinn): needs a person. Only one of the 8 cells (Nursing Home direct Generate, device 3 days slow) has a test (Tim's); the other seven were never written. The run's own result was pass; its evidence is below.

Result: passed in matrix/TC-11.results.json (lane A: the existing Playwright specs below, run on the local stack; agent-matrix.sh).

Existing specs:

  • course-timeline.spec.ts [chromium] — today's line is dated by the server clock, not the device's — expected

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (Tim's spec for the one cell on main, e2e/course-timeline.spec.ts, plus our cells not written yet): page.clock / timezoneId on a fresh @roundai.test account seeded through e2e/support/backend.ts with the local admin key, with mocked model calls; dev has no admin key, one shared account and…. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
